walkthroughs.body_html: Each plane has a partner axis: sagittal plane + transverse axis (somersault), frontal plane + frontal axis (cartwheel), transverse plane + longitudinal axis (discus spin, ice-skater pirouette).
A football kick is a 3rd class lever at the knee (effort from quadriceps between knee joint fulcrum and foot load). It happens in the sagittal plane around the transverse axis, using knee extension.

A calf raise is a 2nd class lever. The effort arm (from ball of foot to ankle muscle) is longer than the load arm, giving mechanical advantage — small force lifts big weight, but the range and speed are limited.
